mapping_json.fidelity_notes: POST-CUTOFF WAND VOLLEY kit (3.27 wand rework; era_year REKEYED 2013->2024 at ingest -- the 2013 stamp was a bulk-fill artifact; probe conf capped <=0.5). PHYSICAL RULE applied: element-neutral, no ailment substrate attested. multi_projectile dominant over chain per s7.2 (the fusillade volley is the every-3s act; the +3 chains extend each bolt -- noted in scaffold). The hover-then-sequential-release economy carried as charge_stack accumulator (accumulator_max=12, in-range 0..100; fill-trigger left unset -- generation event unattested, R-M4 shape-only); the per-prior-projectile crescendo -> MOMENTUM_CASCADE (stacking-capped -> THRESHOLD_BURST, verified Layer-2). Single door: post-cutoff-thin kit, doors express only what the source attests (R-M1). Transfigured variant (of Detonation, 3.28) recorded by stage-1; not mapped.
